fact: Deputy Minister Nzuza says Home Affairs has made investments in building an e-birth registration platform to make birth registration easier and more accessible.
The Minister of Home Affairs replied that the department had rolled out its online birth registration system in 161 health facilities, covering about 68.35% of births delivered.

In a written reply of 5 August 2024 the Minister of Home Affairs says the department has a rollout strategy to automate birth registration by connecting health facilities to Home Affairs systems, under an MOU with the Department of Health, staggered over five years to 2024/25.
